title: The interval of convergence
caption: The ratio of successive terms tends to |2x|, so the series converges for |2x| < 1, that is −½ < x < ½. The radius of convergence is R = ½.
alt: A number line from −1 to 1 with the interval from −½ to ½ shaded, open at both ends, and centre 0.
description: That is −½ < x < ½: an interval centred at 0.
The radius of convergence is ½.
